**What problem does this solve?**

Describe the situation this would help with, not just the feature itself.

**Proposed approach**

If you have one. Not required.

**Does this touch a non-negotiable principle?**

Check `CONTRIBUTING.md`'s "Non-negotiable design principles" section first —
deterministic scoring/identity/security, evidence-backed claims, fail-closed
limits, and no autonomous outbound action are not up for debate. If your
request would require crossing one of those, say so explicitly; it will need a
different shape to be accepted.
